summary: Not Conformant: 1/71 required checks have verified evidence; 1 confirmed finding(s), 5 static signal(s), and 69 evidence gap(s).

findings.finding: The render loop continues while the room is idle.
findings.why_it_matters: The settled environment must request zero animation frames and own no Canvas, WebGL, media, or ambient rendering loop.
findings.recommended_fix: Record a settled performance trace and count requested frames and timers.

findings.why_it_matters: A settled editor-like spatial surface should return to zero optional rendering work.
findings.recommended_fix: Make rendering invalidation-driven, prove a settlement stop, and add an idle trace test.

findings.finding: Three.js appears in a static import path
findings.why_it_matters: The default core should not pay the parsing, memory, and initialization cost of optional volumetric rendering.
findings.recommended_fix: Move Three.js behind a dynamic import reached only by a requested volumetric projection.

findings.finding: WebGL pixel ratio appears to use the full device pixel ratio without a visible cap
findings.why_it_matters: High-density displays can multiply drawing-buffer pixels and thermal cost far beyond the interaction budget.
findings.recommended_fix: Cap physical drawing-buffer pixels or clamp pixel ratio against an explicit budget.

findings.finding: Blur filters and preserve-3d occur in the same stylesheet
findings.why_it_matters: CSS grouping properties can flatten a preserved 3D subtree depending on where they are applied.
findings.recommended_fix: Separate optics from transform-preservation boundaries and add a cross-browser flattening fixture.

findings.finding: CSS motion exists but no prefers-reduced-motion handling was found
findings.why_it_matters: The spatial grammar requires an equivalent comfortable projection, not mandatory travel or ambient motion.
evidence: Scanned 2 supported source files under tests/fixtures/problematic_runtime
findings.recommended_fix: Add reduced-motion behavior that removes travel, blur animation, tilt, and ambient loops while preserving navigation meaning.
